title: Indexing the Data Lake for Online Point Queries
summary: Bypasses the dependent footer-to-page reads that slow lake point queries with RAP, an external key-to-row index.

title: Background Coding Agents: Predictable Results Through Strong Feedback Loops (Honk, Part 3)
summary: Catches agent PRs that fail CI or stray from the prompt with build and test verifiers gating each PR and an LLM judge.

title: Background Coding Agents: Context Engineering (Honk, Part 2)
summary: Replaces a homegrown agent loop that got lost on multi-file edits with Claude Code, large static prompts and few tools.

title: 1,500+ PRs Later: Spotify’s Journey with Our Background Coding Agent (Honk, Part 1)
summary: Swaps Fleet Management's AST and regex scripts, too hard to write for complex changes, for a prompt-driven agent.

title: Large-Scale Generation of ML Podcast Previews at Spotify with Google Dataflow
summary: Replaces Podz's microservices, which could not keep up with new episodes, with a streaming GPU pipeline on Dataflow.

title: Introducing Natural Language Search for Podcast Episodes
summary: Finds episodes that term-matching Elasticsearch missed with fine-tuned dense embeddings served by Vespa ANN.

title: How Spotify Optimized the Largest Dataflow Job Ever for Wrapped 2020
summary: Avoids costly shuffles and Bigtable scale-ups for Wrapped with Sort Merge Bucket files sorted by user_id.

title: Spotify’s Love/Hate Relationship with DNS
summary: Runs Unbound on each host so DNS discovery cannot flood resolvers, and traces outages to firewall and Docker changes.

title: Spotify’s Event Delivery – The Road to the Cloud (Part III)
summary: Fixes slow hourly exports with streaming Dataflow that fills buckets in early panes sized to fit GroupByKey memory.

title: Spotify’s Event Delivery – The Road to the Cloud (Part II)
summary: Picks Cloud Pub/Sub after Kafka 0.8 failed in production, with Mirror Maker dropping data while reporting success.

title: Spotify’s Event Delivery – The Road to the Cloud (Part I)
summary: Shows how a Kafka 0.7 pipeline stalled on cross-continent HDFS acks and missing end-of-file markers, forcing a rewrite.

title: Switching user database on a running system
summary: Moves users off Postgres, whose lone London write master was a single point of failure, to Cassandra via darkloading.

title: Date-Tiered Compaction in Apache Cassandra
summary: Replaces STCS, which mixes data ages so time-series slices hit most SSTables, with DTCS's non-sliding age windows.
